errors.title: Table or namespace not found
causes: table never created in this catalog/namespace
catalog name wrong in the Spark session config

errors.title: Commit conflict
causes: concurrent writers updated the same table
retry the commit; widen isolation level if recurring

errors.title: Catalog resolution failure
causes: catalog impl jar missing from the classpath

errors.title: Snapshot/manifest missing
causes: files expired/deleted while a reader still referenced them
check expire_snapshots and orphan cleanup schedules
